recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中散布許多大細胞，胞質充滿粉紅色圓球狀包涵體（Russell bodies），核被擠壓成小而不規則，箭頭指的就是這種 Mott 細胞。
features: Numerous large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm filled with globular inclusions
Small, compressed, eccentric or central irregular nuclei (arrows)
Mulberry/grape-like appearance of cytoplasmic globules (Russell bodies)
Background of small lymphocytes and hematopoietic cells between fat spaces
describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow shows a cellular interstitial infiltrate between fat spaces containing numerous large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm distended by globular inclusions, compressing small irregular nuclei (arrows). These represent plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells), admixed with small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with a lymphoplasmacytic/plasmacytic process with Mott cell change, as may be seen in marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation; light chain restriction should be assessed.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have homogeneous or finely granular cytoplasm with large multilobated nuclei, not cytoplasm packed with discrete globules.
Myeloma forms sheets of atypical plasma cells without a lymphocytic component; CD138 and light chain IHC quantify and characterize the clone.
Storage histiocytes have striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than round refractile immunoglobulin globules.
